title: World Skydiving Center - Amelia Island - Beach Landings Available

services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: With a focus on your safety and that of our instructors, we welcome guests who weigh up to 240 pounds. A flat fee of $20 is added for guests between 200 and 220 pounds, and a $1 per pound fee applies for guests over 220 pounds.The surcharge is added because the amount of weight under the parachute is important.

services.name: Tandem Skydiving
services.desc: It’s impossible to describe - you tell us when you land! One thing is nearly guaranteed, though, it will be the most invigorating experience you’ve ever had. You won’t get the sinking stomach feeling like what’s often experienced on roller coasters or amusement park rides. With you flying at 120 miles per hour down
